module_summary: Descriptor N:1 mux: an arbiter grants one input port, its descriptor passes through a skid-buffered output register with grant index appended to tag; status is demuxed back by tag bits.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_valid
anchors.why: Per-port descriptor valid; forms arbiter requests and acknowledges.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_ready
anchors.why: Per-port ready, asserted only to the granted port when internal ready.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_addr
anchors.why: Packed per-port descriptor address fields muxed by grant index.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_addr
anchors.why: Muxed descriptor address output to DMA core from output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_valid
anchors.why: Output descriptor valid driven by output valid register.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; controls skid buffer transfers and internal ready.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selects input port fields and is appended to tag.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from arbiter masking requests and forming acknowledge.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid gating input ready and internal valid.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector: valid ports not currently granted.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Arbiter acknowledge when granted port completes a transfer.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_ready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready; gates input acceptance and skid-buffer store decisions.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_tag_int
anchors.why: Output tag formed by concatenating grant index with input tag for routing.

anchors.name: current_s_desc_addr
anchors.why: Selected port's address slice feeding internal datapath.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_valid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid of selected descriptor into the output skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_addr_reg
anchors.why: Output register stage holding descriptor address.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_desc_addr_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer register storing descriptor when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_desc_valid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer full flag; affects internal ready and output refill.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads selected input descriptor directly into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads input descriptor into skid buffer registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves skid buffer contents to output registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Status valid from DMA core, shifted to the port selected by tag.

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_status_tag
anchors.why: Status tag; upper bits route status back to originating port.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Per-port demuxed status valid output from registered decode.

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_len
anchors.why: Registered status length broadcast to all ports.

groups.name: Input arbitration
groups.description: Arbiter instance picks one requesting descriptor port; grant index drives mux.

groups.name: Descriptor input mux
groups.description: Slices granted port fields; appends grant index to tag.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output register plus temp register for full-throughput ready/valid output.

groups.name: Status demux
groups.description: Registers status; routes valid to port named by tag upper bits.
